@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+from .formatting import join_options
+
+
+class OptionBadge(t.TypedDict):
+    """The rendered label for an option on a help card."""
+
+    #: The option spellings, followed by the metavar if there is one.
+    text: str
+    #: Whether any spelling uses a ``/`` prefix, as Windows-style options do.
+    windows_style: bool
+
+
+def option_badge(
+    spellings: cabc.Sequence[str], metavar: str | None = None
+) -> OptionBadge:
+    """Render the label for an option on a help card.
+
+    The spellings are ordered stably by prefix length (unprefixed, then
+    single-character prefixes, then double-character prefixes such as
+    ``--``) and joined with ``", "``. The metavar is appended after a space
+    when both it and the spellings are not empty.
+
+    :param spellings: The option's names, such as ``["--name", "-n"]``.
+    :param metavar: The placeholder shown for the option's value.
+    """
+    text, windows_style = join_options(spellings)
+
+    if text and metavar:
+        text = f"{text} {metavar}"
+
+    return {"text": text, "windows_style": windows_style}

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.option_badge import option_badge
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("spellings", "metavar", "text", "windows_style"),
+    [
+        ([], None, "", False),
+        ([], "NAME", "", False),
+        (["--name", "-n"], None, "-n, --name", False),
+        (["--name", "-n"], "NAME", "-n, --name NAME", False),
+        (["--name", "-n"], "", "-n, --name", False),
+        (["--b", "-a", "c", "--a", "-b"], None, "c, -a, -b, --b, --a", False),
+        (["--debug", "/debug", "-d"], None, "/debug, -d, --debug", True),
+        (("/x",), "VAL", "/x VAL", True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_option_badge(spellings, metavar, text, windows_style):
+    assert option_badge(spellings, metavar) == {
+        "text": text,
+        "windows_style": windows_style,
+    }
decisions: REUSE join_options (src/click/formatting.py) for stable prefix-length ordering, comma-space join and slash detection
NEW because no existing type describes the {text, windows_style} help-card result (OptionBadge TypedDict)
